scope: Corollary 6.4 (Separation supplied by the main test) of the manuscript “Planar Graph Metrics Embed into L1 with Constant Distortion” (preprints/Planar-Graph-Metrics-Embed-into-L1-with-Constant-Distortion-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 089 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 11b3a102e7333bf8), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 26. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let (x, y) be an eligible pair satisfying the interior requirements, 1 ≤ d(x, y) ≤ 2, and |s(x) − s(y)| ≤ EA. If either endpoint has no descending path, then, conditional on main-update mode, the independent cell coins give probability at least 1/4 of system-A symmetric-difference separation at least κAEA at this step.
